key_insight: BenchmarkHub makes biomedical LLM evaluations auditable, showing that answer-grading rules alone can shift accuracy by up to 33.1 percentage points and reorder leaderboards.
clinical_relevance: More transparent benchmarking can support scrutiny of healthcare AI claims, but benchmark performance does not establish clinical safety or effectiveness.
method: Open-source platform with browser, command-line and REST API access.
Fixed-seed sampling, deterministic grading and logging of prompts, replies and tool calls.
Evaluated 12 open-weight models across 15 biomedical and two general benchmarks.
evidence_signal: Pooled accuracy ranged from 46.1% to 80.9%; BenchmarkHub scores were lower than published results in 19 of 23 available comparisons.
watch_item: Prompting effects on MEDQA were not significant after multiple-testing correction with 150 questions, limiting conclusions about prompt superiority.
paper_title: BenchmarkHub: an open-source platform for reproducible evaluation of large language models in healthcare
